title: Overdrive workout, schema 1
description: Native workout format (spec §8.1). Targets are fractions of FTP, durations are seconds. A heart-rate step (type hr, spec §11.2) is the exception: its target is a heart rate and its power limits are absolute watts. ZWO files and intervals.icu workouts are converted to this format on import.

routeId.description: The id of a route (route.schema.json, spec §11.4) that backs a free step: the tablet rides it, its grade feeds the trainer. A free step without it is the flat free ride.

cadence.description: Target cadence in rpm. Shown only; never controls the trainer.

hr.description: Heart-rate hold (spec §11.2): ERG mode whose target power is chosen by a slow controller so that the heart rate stays at the target. Exactly one of target_bpm and target_lthr. power_min < power_max is checked beyond the schema (every implementation does, see the invalid fixtures). No FTP is needed.

target_bpm.description: Target heart rate in beats per minute.

target_lthr.description: Target heart rate as a fraction of the rider's threshold heart rate. The service resolves it to target_bpm from the profile when it serves the workout to the tablet; a workout with this form is only created while a threshold is known.

band.description: Half-width of the band around the target in bpm: the heart rate is inside the band when it is within this many bpm of the target. Compliance for the step is the time inside the band. Default 5.

power_min.description: The least power in watts the controller may command; the start ramp begins here, and it is where the power drops to when the strap signal is lost for 60 s.

power_max.description: The most power in watts the controller may command. Greater than power_min.

steps.description: Repeats do not nest in schema 1.
